# criblio_packs (Data Source)

Returns all matching objects in `items`, following API pagination automatically. Scope the request using the required attributes below. An empty collection returns an empty list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "criblio_packs" "example" {
  group_id = "default"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Worker group ID.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `author` (String) Name or identifier of the Pack author.
- `collectors` (Number) Number of Collectors (saved jobs) configured within the Pack.
- `dependencies` (Map of String) Map of Pack dependency identifiers to their version constraints.
- `description` (String) Brief description of the Pack and its purpose.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable display name for the Pack.
- `exports` (List of String) List of entity IDs exported by this Pack and available for use outside the Pack context.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier.
- `inputs` (Number) Number of Sources configured within the Pack.
- `is_disabled` (Boolean) If <code>true</code>, the Pack is disabled. Otherwise, <code>false</code>.
- `min_log_stream_version` (String) Minimum version of Cribl Stream required to run this Pack.
- `outputs` (Number) Number of Destinations configured within the Pack.
- `settings` (Map of String) Pack-specific settings object. Contents vary by Pack.
- `source` (String) Source of the Pack — a file path, URL, or Git URL from which the Pack was installed.
- `spec` (String) Semver range constraint that was applied when the Pack was installed.
- `tags` (Attributes) Categorization tags for the Pack. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--tags))
- `version` (String) Version of the Pack, following semantic versioning.

<a id="nestedatt--items--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.tags`

Read-Only:

- `data_type` (List of String) List of data type tags for the Pack.
- `domain` (List of String) List of domain tags for the Pack.
- `streamtags` (List of String) List of stream tags for routing and filtering.
- `technology` (List of String) List of technology tags for the Pack.
